Tekuteku is very happy the Nopon
children in town enjoyed them too, mo!

rows.label: tlk70000003_10_msg0002
rows.name:
But that's not the only thing I was
happy about, mo...

rows.label: tlk70000003_10_msg0003
rows.name:
What made Tekuteku happiest was that
you and the shop owner worked hard
together with Tekuteku, mo!

rows.label: tlk70000003_10_msg0004
rows.name:
So please stay friends with Tekuteku
from now on, mo!
